vo: Step one: install Grok Bot. Go to x dot a i slash bot, download the desktop app, and finish the short onboarding.
On the left are your channels and Bots. A channel is a room; Bots are the teammates you put in it.
Create a new channel for this project. I'll call it Ad Factory.
Now press New Bot. Give it a name, AI UGC Studio, and a one-line title: makes video ads from a reference.
The description is optional, but one sentence about your brand helps every answer that follows.
Every Bot works on its own computer in the cloud, so it can download files and run tools while your laptop is closed.
Next, plugins. These give the Bot extra powers, and this setup needs four of them.
Use the search box at the top of the dialog. Type a name, and press Add on the result.
One: a video generation connector, so the Bot can call a model like Seedance directly. This is the engine.
Two: Google Drive, so every finished video lands in a folder you can share.
Three: an X research plugin. X is where marketers post what's working right now, so it's high-signal research.
Four: an ads connector, so a Bot can create campaigns on Meta without you clicking through Ads Manager.
Quick check: ask the Bot, what tools do you have? It should list all four. If one is missing, add it again before you go on.
Now the first real job: find an ad that already works. Don't invent a format, borrow a proven one.
The Meta Ad Library is free. Search your product type and filter to active video ads.
Look for ads that have been running for weeks, with several versions. Nobody keeps paying for an ad that loses.
Open the comments too. If people ask where to buy, or argue about it, the ad is doing its job.
And prefer short, simple ads for your first build: one person, one room, under thirty seconds. They copy cleanly.
I found a simple one: a person wakes up tired, discovers the product, shows it, and asks a question at the end.
Copy the link, paste it into the Bot's chat, and say: download this video and tell me when it's done.
Seconds later, the video is sitting in the chat. Nothing to install, no downloader site.
